response.original_title: ((FAQS Update))- Can you cancel one person on a Carnival cruise?
response.overview: Yes, +1-866-829-1280 you can cancel one person on a Carnival Cruise Line booking, though refunds and fees depend on your timing, fare type, and how many people stay in the cabin. You generally face no cancellation penalty unless you +1-866-829-1280 booked a fare with a non-refundable deposit or cruise price. Final payment is typically due 76 days before sailing for cruises of 5 days or less, and 91 days before sailing for cruises of 6 days or more. Contact Carnival +1-866-829-1280 (or your travel advisor) directly to remove the guest. Check Carnival's Deposit, Final Payment and Cancellation Policy for exact penalty tiers on your sailing.
